req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should URL-decode the <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing them against the supplied Basic credentials. This ensures that special characters in the credentials are correctly handled. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct handling, a negative case to ensure incorrect credentials are rejected, and a boundary case to test the handling of edge cases in URL-decoding.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/%25user/%25pass with correct Basic Auth credentials.
expected: The response JSON indicates successful authentication.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
user, passwd = '%user', '%pass'
encoded_credentials = b64encode(b'user:pass').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {encoded_credentials}'}
response = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{user}/{passwd}', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': '%user'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/%25user/%25pass with incorrect Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
user, passwd = '%user', '%pass'
encoded_credentials = b64encode(b'wrong:credentials').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {encoded_credentials}'}
response = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{user}/{passwd}', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 401

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/%2525user/%2525pass with correct Basic Auth credentials.
expected: The response status code is 401 due to double encoding.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
user, passwd = '%2525user', '%2525pass'
encoded_credentials = b64encode(b'user:pass').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {encoded_credentials}'}
response = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{user}/{passwd}', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 401
